source_locations.location: Crystallographic note [39], CCDC-600834–600836 for compounds 2–4, respectively

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A discrete dimer, [{Cp*Y[(μ-Me)2AlMe2](μ-Cl)}2], with two chloride bridges between formally heptacoordinate Y centers; each Y also binds an η2-coordinated tetramethylaluminate ligand.

synthesis.procedure: In a glovebox, [Cp*Y(AlMe4)2] (1a, 200 mg, 0.50 mmol) was dissolved in hexane (5 mL). A 1 M hexane solution of Me2AlCl (0.9 equiv) was added without stirring at −35 °C. Colorless crystals formed within 5 h at ambient temperature; a further crop was isolated after 7 days.
synthesis.time: 5 h to first crystals; additional crop after 7 days
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystallized from hexane; small amounts of toluene were used to wash away residual starting complex.
synthesis.yield: 77 mg initially (49% based on Me2AlCl), plus 45 mg; 78% overall

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Hexalanthanum tetramethylaluminato/chloro half-sandwich cluster hexane solvate
list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: The La6Al4 cluster comprises two triangular {Cp*3La3Cl4} subunits joined by a strand of four tetramethylaluminate ligands. Chlorides bridge within the subunits, while aluminate methyl groups link the La centers across them. The crystal contains one hexane solvate molecule per cluster.

synthesis.procedure: In a glovebox, [Cp*La(AlMe4)2] (1b, 200 mg, 0.45 mmol) was dissolved in hexane (5 mL). A 1 M hexane solution of Me2AlCl (1 equiv) was added without stirring at −35 °C. Single crystals appeared within 30 min at ambient temperature, and colorless crystals were collected within 2 days.
synthesis.time: Single crystals within 30 min; collection within 2 days
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Colorless single crystals formed from hexane; the crystallographic material retained hexane solvate.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.compound_name: Pentaneodymium tetramethylaluminato/chloro half-sandwich cluster hexane solvate

source_locations.location: Experimental Section, compound 4, referring to the preceding procedure

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: Four Nd centers form a butterfly-shaped chloride-bridged unit. Two μ2-chlorides link it to a fifth Nd center, whose coordination sphere includes Cp* and an η3-coordinated tetramethylaluminate ligand. The crystal contains one hexane solvate molecule per cluster.

synthesis.procedure: Following the preceding unstirred glovebox procedure, [Cp*Nd(AlMe4)2] (1c, 200 mg, 0.46 mmol) was reacted with a 1 M hexane solution of Me2AlCl (1.2 equiv). Blue-green crystals were obtained within 24 h.
synthesis.temperature: −35 °C during addition, following the preceding procedure; subsequently ambient temperature
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Glovebox; unstirred reaction, following the preceding procedure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Blue-green crystals formed from hexane; the crystallographic material retained hexane solvate.
